correctness.rationale: Deleting even vertex 0 from Q_n removes the open-neighborhood simplex F0 in the odd-shore complex but all its edges remain through centers ei+ej. For each other center y, three or more neighbors determine y uniquely, so facetwise elementary apex collapses remove all dimension >=3 cells while retaining a 2-complex. The intact parity complex is simply connected via halved-cube generators gi=e1+ei and filled coordinate squares; every deleted triangle {ei,ej,ek} has the explicit 3-triangle disk using w=ei+ej+ek and surviving centers ei+ej,ej+ek,ek+ei, so π1 stays zero. Removing exactly C(n,r) faces for r>=3 changes χ by C(n−1,2), giving ν_n=2^{n−3}(n²−5n+8)−1−C(n−1,2). Hurewicz/Whitehead yields wedge of ν_n copies of S²; the other parity shore is its Dowker nerve and homotopy equivalent. Independent direct enumeration of all source-neighborhood faces for n=3..7, both shores, gives Euler-derived ν=(0,4,25,101,336). This is a bounded check; all n follow from the facet and disk proof.
